entries.title: product-hold.mjs 返回 missing-payload 未能自动 hold
entries.detail: PR #397 triggered product-gate. Ran product-hold.mjs 397 with scan result on stdin but got held=false reason=missing-payload. Script likely expects a different payload format (possibly the full non-scan context). The PR was also blocked by 14 threads, so practical impact was nil this round.
entries.proposal: Investigate product-hold.mjs expected stdin format and document it, or make the script self-fetch context when not piped

entries.title: product-hold.mjs payload via stdin requires single-line JSON or temp file
entries.detail: heredoc with embedded newlines in JSON values causes parse error; writing to temp file works. This is by-design (JSON spec, not a script bug).

entries.title: 本轮无新进化项：skip 全是 stale-pushback 或 gate 阻断(设计如此)
格式门 uiPaths 对 renderer 下纯音频/逻辑文件误报
entries.detail: PR #373 的 WebMicAudioEngine.ts、useVoiceInput.ts(hook)、vite-env.d.ts 等纯音频生命周期逻辑文件位于 renderer 目录,触发了 UI 证据要求;作者明确说明无视觉变化后仍被推回 3 次。类似 pattern 还包括非渲染 hook、类型声明文件等。
entries.proposal: 在 pr-rules.json 的 uiExcludePaths 中增加 **/vite-env.d.ts、**/*AudioEngine*、renderer/**/use*.ts(仅 hook 文件)等排除模式,或增加「作者在 UI 变化栏明确写明不涉及时不重复推回」的逻辑。需维护者确认排除范围。
entries.note: 维护者 2026-07-25 拍板保守落地:仅排除 .d.ts(commit bfae5f3);AudioEngine/hook 命名类未采纳;renderer 下 __tests__ 测试文件仍会误报,留作后续候选

entries.title: Bot review threads appearing between scan and pre-merge-check is by-design
entries.detail: PR #248: scan showed 0 unresolved threads, but by merge time chatgpt-codex-connector had posted 7 P1 threads. pre-merge-check correctly caught this and prevented merge. No gap — safety net worked as intended.

entries.title: Bot review threads appearing between scan and merge attempt block approved PRs
entries.detail: PR #338: scan showed 0 unresolved threads (gatePass=true), review passed, self-approved, but 5 bot threads (copilot + chatgpt-codex-connector) appeared during the ~7min review window. Branch protection blocks merge with unresolved threads regardless of source. This is by-design: bots are external actors, we cannot control their timing, and the rule 'bot 也不能因是bot而自动忽略' is correct. The practical mitigation is faster processing or resolving bot threads after evaluation.

entries.title: Bot review threads posted between scan and merge block otherwise-clean PR

Resolving external reviewers threads = privilege expansion. Author must resolve; next round will merge if threads cleared.

entries.title: Bot thread appeared between scan and merge — pre-merge-check correctly blocked

entries.title: scan 把 bot 未 resolve thread 计为 softFlag 而非 blocker，与 pre-merge-check 不一致
entries.detail: PR #402 scan 输出 unresolvedThreadCount=0 + softFlags 含 bot 评论，但 pre-merge-check 正确把同一 thread 计为 unresolved→canMerge=false。导致主 agent 无谓走了完整 review+approve 流程后才发现不能 merge。
entries.proposal: context.mjs 的 unresolvedThreadCount 应与 pre-merge-check 口径一致：bot thread 只要未 resolve 就计入 blockers（不论是否 bot），softFlags 保留用于「已 resolve 但内容可能需要人判断」的场景。或在 gate.pass=true 但 softFlags 含 unresolved bot thread 时降级为 gate.pass=false。

entries.title: Scan 模式将 bot unresolved thread 归为 softFlag 而非 blocker，full context 验证时正确拦截
entries.detail: PR #402 被 scan 归为 review(bot thread 是 softFlag)，但 full context 发现 gatePass=false（正确行为）。scan 分类是 hint，实际验证在 full context 阶段兜住。

entries.title: context.mjs 的 UI 证据检测未识别 GitHub blob 链接到图片文件
entries.detail: PR #413 作者在 body 表格里用 GitHub blob URL 链接了 3 张 .webp 截图（因私有仓库无法内嵌渲染），但 bodyUiEvidenceKinds 仍为空，导致 uiEvidenceMissing=true。实际证据充分，主 agent 判断不发误导性提醒评论
entries.proposal: context.mjs 的证据检测增加对 github.com/.../blob/...\.(webp|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg) 格式链接的识别，识别到即视为有效 image 类证据

entries.title: Bot review threads created after scan block merge of approved PRs
entries.detail: PR #449 was approved and ready to merge, but Copilot and Codex bot reviews created new unresolved threads between scan and merge. One thread (Codex DCO) was factually incorrect. Auto mode cannot resolve threads.
entries.proposal: Allow auto-resolving bot threads when: (1) thread author is a known bot, (2) the claim is verifiably false (e.g. DCO signed but bot says not), OR (3) thread is a P2/style suggestion that doesn't block. This is privilege expansion (new resolve action).

entries.title: 模板B停滞私聊在 auto 模式无法自动发送:lark-cli messages-send 的安全约束要求逐条人工确认收件人/内容/身份
entries.detail: PR #251(zhongxingtian-ai)remind-stale-author.mjs 判定 shouldRemind=true,resolve-author-feishu.mjs 已匹配到收件人(钟行天),但发送私聊唯一可用通道是 lark-cli im +messages-send,其技能文档明确写「Do not send messages without explicit user approval」,与 auto 模式设计的自动私聊(模板B)假设冲突。本轮已跳过发送,只记录判定结果,未私聊。
entries.proposal: 方案A:为 auto 模式配置一条不要求逐条确认的专用发送通道(如受限 webhook/机器人群公告代替私聊);方案B:模板B在 --auto 下永久降级为仅记录判定+汇总点名,私聊仅在交互模式下由用户确认发送;需 owner 拍板选哪种,不由 skill 自行决定放宽发送工具的安全约束

entries.title: mivo-canvas 仓库缺 CodeQL/code-quality 工具接线,org ruleset 的 code_scanning/code_quality/required_status_checks 三项永不上报,导致 review 通过的 PR 仍卡在结构性 BLOCKED
entries.detail: 本轮(2026-07-28)候选 #296/#301/#303 均命中 blockClass=structural-check,requiredCheckRules=[code_scanning,code_quality,required_status_checks],required_status_checks 不在 allowlist 内不自动 bypass。#296 审查已通过(PraiseZhu APPROVE)仍卡在此门。连续多轮同一根因,建议 owner 尽快裁定处置方案。
